overall: The AG found no violation: a quorum of the Council may sit on its subcommittee without a separate joint notice if discussion stays within the subcommittee's jurisdiction, and the Council's uncontradicted statement that it did was credited. Resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the nine-member City Council met as its Ordinances and Legislation Subcommittee without posting a joint meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: We have previously determined that a quorum of a public body may sit on its subcommittee without having to post a separate meeting notice, provided that the discussion is limited to matters within the jurisdiction of the subcommittee.
